facts.fact: The StackAdapt blog article 'How to build an industry targeting strategy' was published on 2023-01-26.
StackAdapt's article names eMarketer, Netbase, Environics, Comscore, and Forrester as research tools that are a good starting point for secondary research on buyer personas.
facts.quote: Research tools like eMarketer, Netbase, Environics, Comscore, and Forrester are a good starting point.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's article lists four categories of insights to explore when building buyer personas: demographics, psychographics, behaviour and preferences, and buyer's journey.
facts.quote: When gathering data to build buyer personas, there are a few categories of insights that you'll want to be sure you explore:

facts.fact: StackAdapt defines industry targeting as a digital advertising strategy that segments an audience into groups based on specific industries.
facts.quote: In the world of digital advertising, industry targeting is a strategy that enables you to segment your audience into groups, based on specific industries.
